title: Question 6.2d: Type Handling in Confusion Matrix
instruction: Sometimes data can come in different types. This code handles both possibilities to make the code more robust.
reveal: This code checks what type the data is (Integer or Double) and extracts the integer value accordingly. Spark can return numbers as either Integer or Double depending on the context. The `instanceof` check determines the type, then we either use `.getInt()` directly for Integers or convert a Double to int using `.intValue()`. This makes the code work regardless of which type Spark returns.
